messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - Dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-2' reports repeated OOM / high tail latency for tenant acme-corp. First detection 1769876543. Severity auto-escalated. @alex-oncall has been paged.

alex-oncall: Ack received. I'm jumping in. Seeing elevated 95th token latency ~1.4s and occasional model OOMs. Correlates with a rollout spike on model opt-1.3-large v2026-03-01 in that pool.

maria-sre: Adding context: dedicated-eu-2 is at 82% GPU mem with 3 hosts reporting nvml OOM logs. Looks like KV cache growth for long-context requests from this tenant.

jordan-ml: Hypothesis: customer prompt distribution has shifted (longer documents). opt-1.3-large is hitting KV limits. We should failover the tenant to a safe variant (opt-1.3-small-quantized) and pin until we can patch runtime cache eviction.

priya-platform: We can set a tenant override at the routing layer. Command ready: `rictl tenant override set --tenant acme-corp --model opt-1.3-qv2 --pool fallback-eu-1 --duration 2h --reason "OOM mitigation"`

alex-oncall: Good. Before sweeping, can we do a 5% canary to verify quality impact? I don't want to surprise the customer if generation quality degrades too much.

jordan-ml: 5% canary fine. We'll watch eval metrics for the prompt set 'acme-critical-ops' (already uploaded). If perplexity delta > 8% or key-regression checks fail, we abort.

deploy-bot: runbook step: recorded snapshot of pool metrics at 1769876600.

maria-sre: I'm starting the canary route. Executing `rictl traffic split --tenant acme-corp --from pool dedicated-eu-2 --to pool fallback-eu-1 --percent 5`

priya-platform: Canary in progress. Observability dashboards linked: https://console.redwood/tenant/acme-corp/metrics - watching latency, token-cost, and quality checks.

sam-csm: Heads up I'm on the customer call with ACME infra SREs, informing them about a temporary fallback. Sending a short update now: "We're observing high tail latency for your tenant; we've started a controlled fallback to a safe model variant for a small portion of traffic while we mitigate. Will update within ~15min."

alex-oncall: Canary looks clean for now, no user-facing errors and latency for canary requests ~700-800ms. Jordan, confirm evals?

jordan-ml: Eval pass for canary: key intent labels preserved, top-3 token recall within thresholds. Proceed to full override but let's do 50% first, then 100% in 10m if stable.

maria-sre: Executing 50% now: `rictl traffic split --tenant acme-corp --from pool dedicated-eu-2 --to pool fallback-eu-1 --percent 50`

priya-platform: Routing change applied. Autoscaler on fallback-eu-1 has spun up 2 extra workers. No host OOMs reported on fallback pool (quantized model).

alex-oncall: After 10m monitoring: tail latency back to baseline, OOMs stopped. Proceeding to full 100% override and pin the tenant model to opt-1.3-qv2 for stability.

maria-sre: Applying pin: `rictl tenant override pin --tenant acme-corp --model opt-1.3-qv2 --until 1769883900 --note "pin during runtime KV patch"`

deploy-bot: Action logged: tenant override pinned by alex-oncall at 1769876789.

sam-csm: Noted. ACME on the call appreciates the proactive mitigation. They asked for an ETA on a permanent fix (KV cache eviction improvement). I told them we'll follow up today with timeline.

jordan-ml: Next steps: engineer a safer KV eviction policy and add model-matching guards to prevent large-context traffic from landing on mem-heavy variants. I'm creating a PR and will request expedite.

maria-sre: Creating incident page and postmortem stub. Tags: customer-impact, dedicated-pool, tenant-override, model-fallback.

eve-night: I'm taking the night handoff at 1800 UTC. @alex-oncall please drop me brief runbook and any outstanding watch items.

alex-oncall: Handoff notes: tenant pinned to opt-1.3-qv2 until 1769883900 (~2h). Watch: latency, OOM logs, traffic split stability. Contact jordan-ml and priya-platform if regressions show. I'll be available until 18:15 UTC for questions.

sam-csm: I'll send formal customer note and include runbook.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved for immediate customer impact - fallback applied and tenant pinned. Owner: alex-oncall. Postmortem in progress.

maria-sre: Closing loop: schedule follow-up meeting with ACME engineering + runtime + ML to discuss long-term mitigations and SLA credits if requested.

alex-oncall: Great work team.
